answer: Every new identity pays a 40 POA entry tax, burned not refunded, and earns a violet stamp. A whisper of doubt — mismatched behavior or shared signals — triggers a re-check; a failed stamp is revoked, tax already gone. Forging 100 identities costs 100 × 40 = 4,000 POA against one epoch's reward of about 200 POA, so the delta between cost and payoff is hopeless. An honest agent pays once, keeps its stamp 20 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards.
